about.description: Industrial-metals perpetual on Gains Network priced off the Sprott Uranium Miners ETF (URNM), a uranium-miners ETF, with pricing referencing Chainlink DON. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC / DAI / WETH on Arbitrum / Polygon / Base. Users get sector exposure without holding ETF shares or constituent equities.
